modules.title: Module sources
modules.help: Each product module reads one data source. Folders are discovered by convention, not configured here.

conventions.testhub: Expects a test-platform repo: apps.index_platform, action words, and allowlisted CLIs.
conventions.features: Reads ./*/feature/, and packages/action_words, packages/api_objects, and packages/page_objects when present. Can share TestCopilot's data source.
conventions.environments: Reads config/env.py and env/*.yaml templates plus assets/ddl and assets/sql. Never reads env_local or secret values.
conventions.wiki: Reads docs/ or wiki/ markdown from the bound workdir.
conventions.prd: Reads prd/ markdown from the bound workdir.
